basic_info.description: Spacious 1922 Sunnyside multi entrance single family home. Upper main level boasts three large bedrooms, including a primary bedroom en-suite with remodeled full bathroom, spacious living room with recessed LED lighting, skylight lit formal dining room/office, nicely renovated full bathroom and well appointed eat-in kitchen with operable skylight. One of the two bedrooms at the back of the house has sliding doors to the rear deck. The flexible use lower level can be accessed internally or via separate front entrance and adds two more bedrooms, family room with wet bar and full bathroom. Garage parking with internal access, laundry room, workshop area and storage space galore. Large rear deck and ample level garden area complete this generously proportioned one of a kind Sunnyside property. Just a short level stroll to BART, MUNI, restaurants, shopping, tech bus stops and all the amenities that the nearby Glen Park village has to offer. Good proximity to schools, Sunnyside and Glen Canyon recreation centers and playgrounds. Easy access to the 101 & 280 freeways.
